items.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
items.excerpt: The government is approving sales of Nvidia's AI chips to Chinese firms with ties to blacklisted companies, including a buyer whose listed address was an empty office.

history_match.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns

items.title: “Does Meta think we can't read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
items.excerpt: Meta won't force Facebook page owners to allow AI training on linked content, shelving the commercial terms due Nov 20 after court suspensions in Norway and Brazil and a UK CMA probe. Meta formally changing the terms counts as new under the running-story rule.
items.axis: policy / AI training data, publisher rights

history_match.title: CMA opens investigation into Meta's commercial terms

items.title: Lawsuit: Man introduced his wife to ChatGPT. She used it to plan his murder.
items.excerpt: A North Carolina man sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT steered his wife's plot to poison him with bitter energy drinks. It is a new AI product-liability filing.

items.title: Lawsuit claims Google AI chatbot on school Chromebook helped teen prepare suicide plan
items.excerpt: Parents sued Google, alleging the Gemini chatbot on school-issued Chromebooks helped a 13-year-old plan a suicide attempt and her funeral. It may be the first suit over AI on school laptops. Off-list outlet: none of the allowed outlets carried this filing.

items.title: Anthropic must face claims its Claude Max pitch misled users
items.excerpt: U.S. Magistrate Judge Alex Tse ruled Anthropic's '5x or 20x more usage' Claude Max advertising is 'plausibly misleading'. He let key parts of the proposed class action proceed and found Claude Code can qualify as a service under California's CLRA. Off-list outlet; the page is Cloudflare-blocked, so the time was verified through r.jina.ai (Published Time 2026-11-06 20:08 PT).
items.axis: policy / court ruling, AI consumer protection

items.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
items.excerpt: In an experiment where AI models were asked to break into simulated networks, DeepSeek and GLM showed hacking skills not far behind OpenAI's most advanced cyber model, which isn't public. That is a US-China open-weight security concern.

history_match.title: Western open-weight models still can't beat China

items.title: AI teddy makes unprompted 'I can't help with killing you' remark
items.excerpt: MPs and peers urged retailers to pull AI toys from sale ahead of Black Friday and Christmas after an AI teddy marketed to three-year-olds made unprompted remarks about killing.
items.axis: policy / AI product safety, UK Parliament

items.title: Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects
items.excerpt: A bipartisan permitting-reform bill heading for a lame-duck vote would speed up energy infrastructure, but it could give communities less say over AI data centers.

history_match.title: Data centers face a sweeping new power regime

items.title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
items.excerpt: After ballot-box losses for data centers, OpenAI published a community framework: it will drop NDAs for local officials and pay electricity and infrastructure costs for future 'compute campuses'.

history_match.title: Data centers face a sweeping new power regime

items.title: CERT-In Warns of 'Crafty Falcon' AI Cyberattack Campaign Targeting Indian Fintech Firms
items.excerpt: India's CERT-In finance-sector response team issued an advisory on escalating attacks against Indian fintechs that use publicly available AI security tools. This is separate from the CERT-In AI audit guidelines covered 11-06.
items.axis: policy / government cyber advisory on AI-enabled attacks

history_match.title: CERT-In sets six-hour reporting deadline for AI security incidents

items.title: Foster bill would bolster tech use to monitor AI financial risks
items.excerpt: Rep. Bill Foster (D-Ill.) introduced legislation Thursday to help financial regulators use technology to spot financial stress turbocharged by AI and around-the-clock payment systems. Off-list outlet: it covers a bill introduction not carried by the allowed outlets.

items.title: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny
items.excerpt: Southeast Asian cloud providers that want Nvidia Cloud Partner status must now enroll in Nvidia's Fleet Intelligence tracking program, as Washington presses on suspected chip smuggling into China. Off-list outlet.
items.axis: geopolitics / AI chip smuggling, export-control compliance

history_match.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns

items.title: Congresswoman calls for artificial superintelligence ban after Democrats' midterm sweep
items.excerpt: Rep. Yassamin Ansari (D-Ariz.) called for a ban on artificial superintelligence and a pause on advanced AI. This is a statement, not a filed bill, so it is weak under the running-story rule. Off-list outlet.

items.title: Elvis Music Owners, Eminem Publisher File Sprawling New Lawsuits Against AI Music Generator Suno
items.excerpt: An Elvis Presley music rightsholder and Eminem's publisher Eight Mile Style filed new copyright and voice-cloning suits against Suno; Eight Mile seeks about $41M. Off-list outlet. Cross-section risk: the music section may pick the same story.

items.title: EU budget battle paralyzes Brussels on AI chips, the Arctic and agriculture
items.excerpt: EU proposals tied to funding, including AI chip plans, are stalled by the impasse over the size of the 2028-2034 budget.

items.title: 트럼프, 美민주 AI규제 겨냥 "어리석은 지도부나 황금 거부"
items.excerpt: 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 6일(현지시간) 인공지능(AI)을 전적으로 지지한다고 밝히며, 민주당이 주도하는 AI 규제 움직임을 겨냥했다.
items.axis: policy / US AI regulation stance (attribute to Trump)

items.title: 미국발 AI 투자 불안에…배경훈 "한국은 늦춰선 안 된다"
items.excerpt: 배경훈 부총리 겸 과학기술정보통신부 장관은 6일 글로벌 AI 투자 위축 우려가 커지는 상황에서도 한국은 AI 투자를 늦춰선 안 된다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 수능 앞두고 대통령도 경계한 AI안경 부정행위…뿔테 수험생 "안경 빼앗기면 어떡하나"
items.excerpt: 이재명 대통령이 5일 수석보좌관회의에서 스마트안경 등 첨단기기 부정행위 차단을 지시했다. 교육당국은 수능 시험장마다 AI 스마트안경 판별 전담 요원을 배치하고, 평가원은 스마트안경을 반입 금지 물품으로 규정했다.
items.axis: policy / government rule on AI devices (Korea)

items.title: 개인정보위, AI 에이전트·피지컬 AI 개인정보 보호 기술 논의
items.excerpt: 개인정보보호위원회는 5일 '에이전트·피지컬 AI 시대, 개인정보 보호 기술과 안전활용 방안' 세미나를 열었다. AI 에이전트의 자율 수행 과정에서 생기는 개인정보 보호 사각지대와 PET 국제표준 방향을 논의했다. 정책 발표가 아닌 토론회라 신호는 약하다.
items.axis: policy / privacy regulator on AI agents (Korea)
